sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.event_ticker from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.market_ticker like 'KXMLB%'), s as (select substring(f.market_ticker from 'KXMLB[A-Z0-9]*-([0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2})') as settle_date, substring(f.market_ticker from 'KXMLB[A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}([0-9]{4}[A-Z]+)') as game, f.market_ticker, (select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as realized from f) select settle_date, count(distinct game) as games, count(*) as markets, count(*) filter (where coalesce(realized,0)<0) as losing_markets, count(distinct game) filter (where coalesce(realized,0)<0) as losing_games, round(sum(coalesce(realized,0))::numeric,2) as realized_usd from s group by settle_date order by settle_date
